description: Soil landscape land quality - Wind Erosion Risk (DPIRD-016) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. Wind Erosion risk mapping derived from land quality attribution associated with soil-landscape mapping at the subsystem/phase level. See Resource Management Technical Report 298, Section 2. 22, Department of Agriculture, 2005. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. Its tags are Harvested, SLIP Future, agricultural, agriculture, environment. It offers 11 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, docx, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
